questions.instructions: The picture_select question type uses images as the selectable options themselves. Pick whichever you'd rather look at. This default layout wraps the images in a centered row.
Same options with auto_resize: true — both images render at the same height (the smallest natural height in the group), so the row lines up neatly.

With horizontal: false the images stack in a centered column. auto_resize here matches every image's width to the smallest natural width. (Integer values are stored as an integer column automatically.)

The image_click question type stores the participant's click position on an image. With the default max_clicks: 1 and required: true, each click moves a single crosshair, and the Continue button stays disabled until at least one click is placed. Coordinates are saved as natural-image pixels in two columns: click_target_x and click_target_y.

Setting max_clicks above 1 lets the participant place several markers (a fourth click here drops the oldest). The points are saved as a JSON array in a single text column called click_spots, in click order.
